name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Yokohama-kou Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 横浜港連続殺人事件
source:
In the second mystery, the search for a missing girlfriend results in the discovery of her hiding guns, and the police begin to suspect a link with an underground trafficking organization.

[From [url=https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tantei_Jinguuji_Saburou:_Yokohama-kou_Renzoku_Satsujin_Jiken]strategywiki[/url]]
translation:
第二起案件中，寻找失踪女友的调查发现她藏匿的枪支，警方开始怀疑她与地下走私组织有关。

[来源：[url=https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tantei_Jinguuji_Saburou:_Yokohama-kou_Renzoku_Satsujin_Jiken]StrategyWiki[/url]]
